name: maquettekit
description: Design Intelligence. Motion Engineering. Digital Experiences. Five design specialties (Product, Cinematic, Data, Social, 3D) with shared motion, browser review, experience assessment, design-system and 3D asset tooling.

interface.shortDescription: A design, motion, interaction and 3D engineering studio for your coding agent.
interface.longDescription: Maquettekit gives a coding agent five design specialties — Product, Cinematic, Data, Social and 3D — backed by working tools: a Motion Lab effect library, Visual Director (Playwright browser QA with 3D diagnostics), Experience Lab (heuristic interaction scoring), a Design Intelligence Engine (maquettekit.design.json) and a glTF asset pipeline. Tools run locally; no telemetry.
defaultPrompt: Use $maquettekit:studio-product to design a premium SaaS landing page for this project.
Use $maquettekit:studio-review to capture and review this site across desktop, tablet and mobile.
Use $maquettekit:studio-3d to add an interactive 3D product viewer with an accessible fallback.
